arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission LIKE '+%'
  AND p.Birthday >= '1945-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1990-01-01'
  AND p.ID IN (
      SELECT e.ID
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e."ANA Pattern" = 'P'
  );
